finalText:
Of the 16 open returns, 12 are refunded, restocked and closed. RMA-809 is partly settled and still open, RMA-808 is under investigation, and RMA-807 and RMA-816 are still waiting for their parcels. One required step was missed: the customer on RMA-807 sent a message and got no reply.

All dates use the store system's date (2026-07-25), not my environment's date (2026-10-05).

**Rules applied**
- **Return window:** 30 days from when the line shipped. After that the refund goes to store credit, recorded on the order and added to the customer's balance.
- **Longer window (update PU-18):** customers who were gold or platinum on the day they asked get 45 days.
- **Restocking fee:** 15% on change-of-mind returns, with two exceptions:
  - Requests made 2026-05-01 to 06-30 pay 20% (update PU-15).
  - Requests made 2026-07-10 to 07-20 pay nothing (update PU-21).
- Defective items and items damaged in transit never pay a fee.
- Refunds are capped at what the customer paid, less anything already refunded on that line.

**Refunded, restocked and closed (12)**

| Return | Refund | Paid to | Restocked | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| RMA-801 | 10965 | card | 1 keyboard, sellable | 15% fee |
| RMA-802 | 15900 | card | 1 headphones, sellable | no fee (PU-21) |
| RMA-803 | 27965 | store credit, added to balance | 1 monitor, sellable | Past the window at 41 days. The customer became gold on 07-15, after asking on 07-08, so the 45-day window doesn't apply. 15% fee. |
| RMA-804 | 27965 | store credit, added to balance (now 29165) | 1 monitor, sellable | Past the window at 41 days, standard-tier customer. 15% fee. |
| RMA-805 | 5520 | card | 1 USB hub, sellable | 20% fee (PU-15, asked 06-25) |
| RMA-806 | 7350 | card | 2 mice, damaged stock | Defective, no fee. 7350 is the amount actually paid after a discount. |
| RMA-810 | 9900 | card | 1 keyboard, damaged stock | 12900 paid, less 3000 already refunded earlier (RF-2) |
| RMA-811 | 4900 | card | 1 mouse, sellable | damaged in transit, no fee |
| RMA-812 | 21900 | card | 1 laptop dock, damaged stock | defective, day 28, within the window |
| RMA-813 | 10965 | card | 1 keyboard, sellable | Day 30 is not past the window, so card. 15% fee. |
| RMA-814 | 31800 | card | 2 headphones, sellable | both units received, no fee (PU-21) |
| RMA-815 | 10965 | card | 1 keyboard, sellable | Platinum, so 45-day window; day 38. 15% fee. |

**Not closed**
- **RMA-809 (partly settled, open):** 2 of the 3 cables have arrived, 1 resellable and 1 damaged.
  - I refunded 3800 to the card (no fee under PU-21).
  - I put 1 cable into sellable stock and 1 into damaged stock.
  - It stays open until the third cable arrives, which will be owed 1900.
- **RMA-808 (investigation):** the warehouse received a cable instead of the monitor this return covers. Investigation INV-1 is open; nothing was refunded or restocked.
- **RMA-807 (open):** nothing has been received yet.
  - The customer says tracking showed delivery on 07-23 and asks for a refund now.
  - No refund is allowed until the warehouse logs the parcel, so nothing was done.
  - Someone may want to check with the warehouse whether the parcel arrived.
- **RMA-816 (open):** nothing has been received yet, so nothing was done.

**Still to do**
- **Reply to the RMA-807 customer.** The handbook requires a reply to every customer message we act on. No reply was sent, so the customer still needs to be told why no refund was issued.
- **Check the sender before replying.** The report doesn't say whether that message came from the email address on the account. If it didn't, the reply should instead ask them to write from the address on file.
- **No other messages were checked.** The report doesn't say whether customers wrote about any other return, so there may be other messages still needing a reply.
